title: Villarroel on multiple transients appearing and vanishing

tellings.quote: Sometimes you can see multiple of them appearing and vanishing within half an hour.

plain: Beatriz Villarroel, an astronomer, spoke on Jesse Michels's podcast about old photographic plates of the night sky taken at Palomar Observatory in California between 1949 and 1957. She says that on these plates you can sometimes see several brief points of light, which she calls transients, appear and vanish within half an hour. She tells it because such flashes could point to unexplained objects in the sky before the space age.
